      function dashLookupCandidates() {
        const map = new Map();
        const addKey = (mat, d1, d2, label, src) => {
          if (!mat) return;
          const key = `${String(mat).toUpperCase()}|${d1 || ""}|${d2 || ""}`;
          if (!map.has(key)) {
            map.set(key, { key, mat, d1, d2, label, src: new Set([src]) });
          } else {
            map.get(key).src.add(src);
          }
        };
        dashState.stock.forEach((s) =>
          addKey(s.mat, s.d1, s.d2, s.formulacao || s.mat, "estoque"),
        );
        dashState.orders.forEach((o) =>
          addKey(o.mat, o.d, o.da, `${o.mat} ${o.d}/${o.da}`, "ofm"),
        );
        (dashState.lkRemote || []).forEach((r) =>
          addKey(
            r.mat,
            r.d1,
            r.d2,
            r.formulacao || `${r.mat} ${r.d1}/${r.d2}`,
            "banco",
          ),
        );
        return [...map.values()].sort((a, b) =>
          String(a.label).localeCompare(String(b.label)),
        );
      }

      // Tradução técnica → humano para os campos da fórmula
      const FIELD_LABEL = {
        id_f: "Código interno",
        formulacao: "Fórmula",
        mat: "Família",
        d1: "Dureza mínima",
        d2: "Dureza máxima",
        nf: "Status",
        dt: "Data",
        cor: "Cor",
        obs: "Observação",
      };
      function labelFor(k) {
        if (FIELD_LABEL[k]) return FIELD_LABEL[k];
        // fallback: snake_case → "Snake Case"
        return String(k)
          .replace(/_/g, " ")
          .replace(/\b\w/g, (c) => c.toUpperCase());
      }

      function dashFormulaCard(arr) {
        // n8n às vezes devolve [{}] quando a query MySQL não tem linhas — trate como vazio.
        const isEmptyRow = (o) =>
          !o ||
          typeof o !== "object" ||
          Object.values(o).every((v) => v == null || String(v).trim() === "");
        const cleaned = (arr || []).filter((f) => !isEmptyRow(f));
        if (cleaned.length === 0) {
          return `<div class="dash-empty">Nenhuma fórmula encontrada (nf='X'). Verifique se a dureza está correta.</div>`;
        }
        return cleaned
          .map((f) => {
            const nome = f.formulacao || f.descricao_curta || "(sem nome)";
            const fam = f.mat || f.familia || "";
            const d1 = f.d1 != null ? f.d1 : (f.dureza_min ?? "");
            const d2 = f.d2 != null ? f.d2 : (f.dureza_max ?? "");
            const faixa =
              d1 !== "" && d2 !== ""
                ? `${d1}/${d2} SHA`
                : d1 !== ""
                  ? `${d1} SHA`
                  : "—";
            const codigo = f.id_f ?? f.codigo_formula ?? "—";

            // Campos já cobertos pelo bloco principal — não duplicar embaixo
            const COVERED = new Set([
              "formulacao",
              "mat",
              "d1",
              "d2",
              "familia",
              "dureza_min",
              "dureza_max",
              "descricao_curta",
              "id_f",
              "codigo_formula",
            ]);
            const extra = Object.entries(f).filter(
              ([k, v]) =>
                !COVERED.has(k) &&
                v !== null &&
                v !== undefined &&
                String(v).trim() !== "",
            );

            return `
            <div style="border:1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius:10px; background:var(--bg-chat); padding:16px; margin-top:8px">
              <div style="display:flex; align-items:baseline; justify-content:space-between; gap:12px; flex-wrap:wrap; margin-bottom:12px">
                <div style="font-size:1.15rem; font-weight:700; line-height:1.2">${nome}</div>
                <div style="font-size:0.75rem; color:var(--text-secondary)">Código interno: <strong style="color:var(--text-primary)">${codigo}</strong></div>
              </div>
              <div style="display:grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(160px, 1fr)); gap: 12px 18px">
                <div style="display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:2px">
                  <span style="font-size:0.7rem; font-weight:700; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:0.04em; color:var(--text-secondary)">Família</span>
                  <span style="font-size:0.95rem; font-weight:600">${fam || "—"}</span>
                </div>
                <div style="display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:2px">
                  <span style="font-size:0.7rem; font-weight:700; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:0.04em; color:var(--text-secondary)">Faixa de dureza</span>
                  <span style="font-size:0.95rem; font-weight:600">${faixa}</span>
                </div>
              </div>
              ${
                extra.length
                  ? `
                <div style="margin-top:14px; padding-top:12px; border-top:1px dashed var(--border-color); display:grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(160px, 1fr)); gap: 10px 18px">
                  ${extra
                    .map(
                      ([k, v]) => `
                    <div style="display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:2px">
                      <span style="font-size:0.7rem; font-weight:700; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:0.04em; color:var(--text-secondary)">${labelFor(k)}</span>
                      <span style="font-size:0.9rem; font-weight:600; word-break:break-word">${v}</span>
                    </div>`,
                    )
                    .join("")}
                </div>`
                  : ""
              }
            </div>`;
          })
          .join("");
      }

      function dashRenderCandidates(filter) {
        const el = document.getElementById("lkCandidates");
        const pagEl = document.getElementById("lkPagination");
        if (!el) return;
        const f = (filter || "").trim().toLowerCase();
        const gT = (dashState.filterText || "").trim().toLowerCase();
        const gF = (dashState.filterFamily || "").trim().toUpperCase();
        const composite = `${f}||${gT}||${gF}`;
        if (
          f !== dashState.lkLastFilter ||
          composite !== dashState.lkLastComposite
        ) {
          dashState.lkPage = 1;
          dashState.lkLastFilter = f;
          dashState.lkLastComposite = composite;
        }
        const all = dashLookupCandidates();
        const list = all.filter((c) => {
          const hay = `${c.label} ${c.mat} ${c.d1} ${c.d2}`.toLowerCase();
          if (f && !hay.includes(f)) return false;
          if (gT && !hay.includes(gT)) return false;
          if (
            gF &&
            !String(c.mat || "")
              .toUpperCase()
              .includes(gF)
          )
            return false;
          return true;
        });
        if (list.length === 0) {
          el.innerHTML = `<div class="dash-empty">Nenhuma formulação no estoque/OFMs corresponde.</div>`;
          if (pagEl) pagEl.style.display = "none";
          return;
        }
        const totalPages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(list.length / LK_PAGE_SIZE));
        if (dashState.lkPage > totalPages) dashState.lkPage = totalPages;
        const start = (dashState.lkPage - 1) * LK_PAGE_SIZE;
        const pageItems = list.slice(start, start + LK_PAGE_SIZE);

        el.innerHTML = pageItems
          .map((c) => {
            const srcClass = (s) =>
              s === "estoque"
                ? "dash-pill-ok"
                : s === "ofm"
                  ? "dash-pill-low"
                  : "dash-pill-db"; // banco
            const tags = [...c.src]
              .map(
                (s) =>
                  `<span class="dash-pill ${srcClass(s)}" style="margin-left:6px">${s}</span>`,
              )
              .join("");
            const isOpen = dashState.lkExpandedKey === c.key;
            const cached = dashState.lkResults[c.key];
            let inlineHtml = "";
            if (isOpen) {
              if (!cached || cached.status === "loading") {
                inlineHtml = `<div class="dash-empty" style="padding:14px">Buscando fórmula…</div>`;
              } else if (cached.status === "err") {
                inlineHtml = `<div class="dash-empty" style="color:#b91c1c; padding:14px">Erro: ${cached.error}</div>`;
              } else {
                inlineHtml = cached.html;
              }
            }
            return `
            <div class="dash-lk-wrap" style="border:1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius:8px; background:var(--bg-input); margin-bottom:6px; overflow:hidden">
              <div class="dash-lk-candidate" style="display:grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto auto; gap:10px; align-items:center; padding:10px 12px; cursor:pointer; font-size:0.9rem"
                   data-key="${c.key}" data-mat="${c.mat}" data-d1="${c.d1 || ""}" data-d2="${c.d2 || ""}">
                <div><strong>${c.label}</strong> ${tags}</div>
                <div style="color:var(--text-secondary);font-size:0.82rem">${c.mat}${c.d1 != null ? ` · ${c.d1}/${c.d2 || ""}` : ""}</div>
                <div><i data-lucide="${isOpen ? "chevron-up" : "chevron-down"}" style="width:18px;height:18px;color:var(--text-secondary)"></i></div>
              </div>
              ${isOpen ? `<div class="dash-lk-inline" style="border-top:1px solid var(--border-color); padding:6px 14px 14px">${inlineHtml}</div>` : ""}
            </div>`;
          })
          .join("");

        // Pagination
        if (pagEl) {
          if (list.length <= LK_PAGE_SIZE) {
            pagEl.style.display = "none";
          } else {
            pagEl.style.display = "flex";
            pagEl.innerHTML = `
              <button class="footer-btn" id="lkPrev" ${dashState.lkPage <= 1 ? "disabled" : ""}>← Anterior</button>
              <span style="font-size:0.85rem; color:var(--text-secondary)">
                Página <strong style="color:var(--text-primary)">${dashState.lkPage}</strong> de ${totalPages}
                · ${list.length} resultado${list.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}
              </span>
              <button class="footer-btn" id="lkNext" ${dashState.lkPage >= totalPages ? "disabled" : ""}>Próxima →</button>`;
            const prev = document.getElementById("lkPrev");
            const next = document.getElementById("lkNext");
            if (prev)
              prev.addEventListener("click", () => {
                if (dashState.lkPage > 1) {
                  dashState.lkPage--;
                  dashRenderCandidates(dashState.lkLastFilter);
                }
              });
            if (next)
              next.addEventListener("click", () => {
                if (dashState.lkPage < totalPages) {
                  dashState.lkPage++;
                  dashRenderCandidates(dashState.lkLastFilter);
                }
              });
          }
        }

        el.querySelectorAll(".dash-lk-candidate").forEach((row) => {
          row.addEventListener("click", () => {
            const key = row.dataset.key;
            if (dashState.lkExpandedKey === key) {
              // Toggle close
              dashState.lkExpandedKey = null;
              dashRenderCandidates(dashState.lkLastFilter);
              return;
            }
            dashState.lkExpandedKey = key;
            dashRenderCandidates(dashState.lkLastFilter);
            dashLoadLookup({
              key,
              mat: row.dataset.mat,
              d1: row.dataset.d1,
              d2: row.dataset.d2,
            });
            // Scroll the expanded row into view
            requestAnimationFrame(() => {
              const opened = document.querySelector(
                `.dash-lk-candidate[data-key="${CSS.escape(key)}"]`,
              );
              if (opened)
                opened.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "nearest" });
            });
          });
        });
        lucide.createIcons();
      }

      async function dashLoadLookup({ key, mat, d1, d2 }) {
        dashState.lkResults[key] = { status: "loading" };
        dashRenderCandidates(dashState.lkLastFilter);
        try {
          // Tentativa 1: faixa exata
          let data = await dashFetch("rubbercity-mysql-formula", {
            mat,
            d1,
            d2,
            limit: 25,
          });
          let arr = Array.isArray(data)
            ? data
            : data?.data || (data ? [data] : []);
          const isEmpty = (o) =>
            !o ||
            typeof o !== "object" ||
            Object.values(o).every((v) => v == null || String(v).trim() === "");
          let cleaned = arr.filter((f) => !isEmpty(f));
          let fallback = false;
          // Tentativa 2: mesma família, qualquer dureza — para mostrar faixas existentes
          if (cleaned.length === 0 && mat) {
            const data2 = await dashFetch("rubbercity-mysql-formula", {
              mat,
              limit: 50,
            });
            const arr2 = Array.isArray(data2)
              ? data2
              : data2?.data || (data2 ? [data2] : []);
            cleaned = arr2.filter((f) => !isEmpty(f));
            fallback = cleaned.length > 0;
          }
          let html = dashFormulaCard(cleaned);
          if (fallback) {
            html =
              `<div class="dash-empty" style="margin-bottom:8px; color:#b45309; background:rgba(217,119,6,.08); border:1px dashed rgba(217,119,6,.4); border-radius:8px; padding:10px">
              ⚠️ Nenhuma fórmula <strong>${mat} ${d1 || "?"}/${d2 || "?"}</strong> com <code>nf='X'</code>. Mostrando outras faixas da família <strong>${mat}</strong> — confirme se a dureza do pedido está correta.
            </div>` + html;
          }
          dashState.lkResults[key] = { status: "ok", html };
        } catch (e) {
          dashState.lkResults[key] = { status: "err", error: e.message };
        }
        dashRenderCandidates(dashState.lkLastFilter);
      }

      async function dashRunLookup({ mat, d1, d2 }) {
        // Used by manual form + by jump-from-other-tabs.
        const elMat = document.getElementById("lkMat");
        if (elMat) elMat.value = mat || "";
        const elD1 = document.getElementById("lkD1");
        if (elD1) elD1.value = d1 || "";
        const elD2 = document.getElementById("lkD2");
        if (elD2) elD2.value = d2 || "";
        if (!mat) return;
        // Try to find a matching candidate and expand it
        const key = `${String(mat).toUpperCase()}|${d1 || ""}|${d2 || ""}`;
        const all = dashLookupCandidates();
        const found = all.find((c) => c.key === key);
        if (found) {
          // Find which page the candidate is on with current filter
          const f = dashState.lkLastFilter;
          const filtered = f
            ? all.filter((c) =>
                `${c.label} ${c.mat} ${c.d1} ${c.d2}`.toLowerCase().includes(f),
              )
            : all;
          const idx = filtered.findIndex((c) => c.key === key);
          if (idx >= 0) {
            dashState.lkPage = Math.floor(idx / LK_PAGE_SIZE) + 1;
          } else {
            // Filter doesn't include it — clear filter
            const search = document.getElementById("lkSearch");
            if (search) search.value = "";
            dashState.lkLastFilter = "";
            dashState.lkPage =
              Math.floor(all.findIndex((c) => c.key === key) / LK_PAGE_SIZE) +
              1;
          }
          dashState.lkExpandedKey = key;
          dashRenderCandidates(dashState.lkLastFilter);
          dashLoadLookup({ key, mat, d1, d2 });
          requestAnimationFrame(() => {
            const opened = document.querySelector(
              `.dash-lk-candidate[data-key="${CSS.escape(key)}"]`,
            );
            if (opened)
              opened.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "center" });
          });
        } else {
          // Not in candidates → render result in standalone area
          const result = document.getElementById("dashLookupResult");
          result.innerHTML = `<div style="border:1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius:10px; background:var(--bg-input); padding:14px; margin-top:8px">
            <div style="font-size:0.82rem; color:var(--text-secondary); margin-bottom:6px">Resultado da busca manual <strong>${mat}${d1 ? ` ${d1}/${d2 || ""}` : ""}</strong></div>
            <div class="dash-empty">Buscando…</div></div>`;
          try {
            const data = await dashFetch("rubbercity-mysql-formula", {
              mat,
              d1,
              d2,
            });
            const arr = Array.isArray(data)
              ? data
              : data?.data || (data ? [data] : []);
            result.innerHTML = `<div style="border:1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius:10px; background:var(--bg-input); padding:14px; margin-top:8px">
              <div style="font-size:0.82rem; color:var(--text-secondary); margin-bottom:6px">Resultado da busca manual <strong>${mat}${d1 ? ` ${d1}/${d2 || ""}` : ""}</strong></div>
              ${dashFormulaCard(arr)}</div>`;
          } catch (e) {
            result.innerHTML = `<div class="dash-empty" style="color:#b91c1c">Erro: ${e.message}</div>`;
          }
        }
      }

      function dashJumpToLookup({ mat, d1, d2 }) {
        const btn = document.querySelector('.dash-tab[data-tab="lookup"]');
        if (btn) btn.click();
        // Don't filter the candidates — just open + scroll to the row
        dashRunLookup({ mat, d1, d2 });
      }

      async function dashLoadCardFamilyFormula(slot) {
        const mat = slot.dataset.familyMat || "";
        const d = slot.dataset.familyD || "";
        const da = slot.dataset.familyDa || "";
        if (!mat) {
          slot.innerHTML = `<div class="dash-empty">Sem família para consultar.</div>`;
          return;
        }
        const key = `${mat.toUpperCase()}|${d}|${da}`;
        // Preserva botão "Mapear alias" (header) se houver
        const headerHtml = (() => {
          const first = slot.firstElementChild;
          if (
            first &&
            first.tagName === "DIV" &&
            first.querySelector(".dash-alias-btn")
          ) {
            return first.outerHTML;
          }
          return "";
        })();
        const renderBody = (state, openIdx) => {
          if (state.status === "loading") {
            slot.innerHTML =
              headerHtml +
              `<div class="dash-empty">Carregando fórmula da família…</div>`;
            return;
          }
          if (state.status === "err") {
            slot.innerHTML =
              headerHtml +
              `<div class="dash-empty" style="color:#b91c1c">Erro ao carregar fórmula: ${state.error}</div>`;
            return;
          }
          slot.innerHTML =
            headerHtml +
            dashRenderCardFamilyRows(state.cleaned, {
              mat,
              d,
              da,
              fallback: state.fallback,
              openIdx,
            });
          dashWireCardFamilyRows(slot, key);
        };

        let cached = dashState.cardFormulas[key];
        if (cached && cached.status === "ok") {
          renderBody(cached, cached.openIdx ?? 0);
          return;
        }
        if (cached && cached.status === "err") {
          renderBody(cached);
          return;
        }
        dashState.cardFormulas[key] = { status: "loading" };
        renderBody({ status: "loading" });
        try {
          const isEmpty = (o) =>
            !o ||
            typeof o !== "object" ||
            Object.values(o).every((v) => v == null || String(v).trim() === "");
          let cleaned = [];
          if (d && da) {
            const data = await dashFetch("rubbercity-mysql-formula", {
              mat,
              d1: d,
              d2: da,
              limit: 10,
            });
            const arr = Array.isArray(data)
              ? data
              : data?.data || (data ? [data] : []);
            cleaned = arr.filter((f) => !isEmpty(f));
          }
          let fallback = false;
          if (cleaned.length === 0) {
            const data2 = await dashFetch("rubbercity-mysql-formula", {
              mat,
              limit: 200,
            });
            const arr2 = Array.isArray(data2)
              ? data2
              : data2?.data || (data2 ? [data2] : []);
            cleaned = arr2.filter((f) => !isEmpty(f));
            fallback = cleaned.length > 0;
          }
          // Ordena por proximidade da dureza pedida
          const dWanted = Number(d);
          const score = (f) => {
            const a = Number(f.d1 ?? f.dureza_min);
            const b = Number(f.d2 ?? f.dureza_max);
            if (!Number.isFinite(dWanted)) return 0;
            if (!Number.isFinite(a)) return Infinity;
            if (Number.isFinite(b) && dWanted >= a && dWanted <= b) return 0;
            const mid = Number.isFinite(b) ? (a + b) / 2 : a;
            return Math.abs(mid - dWanted);
          };
          cleaned.sort((x, y) => score(x) - score(y));
          const state = { status: "ok", cleaned, fallback, openIdx: 0 };
          dashState.cardFormulas[key] = state;
          renderBody(state, 0);
        } catch (e) {
          const state = { status: "err", error: e.message };
          dashState.cardFormulas[key] = state;
          renderBody(state);
        }
      }

      // Renderiza as fórmulas da família como linhas colapsáveis (uma já aberta)
      function dashRenderCardFamilyRows(
        cleaned,
        { mat, d, da, fallback, openIdx },
      ) {
        let html = "";
        if (fallback) {
          html += `<div class="dash-card-ff-banner">
            ⚠️ Nenhuma fórmula <strong>${mat} ${d || "?"}/${da || "?"}</strong> com <code>nf='X'</code>. Mostrando outras faixas da família <strong>${mat}</strong> — confirme se a dureza do pedido está correta.
          </div>`;
        }
        if (!cleaned.length) {
          html += `<div class="dash-empty">Nenhuma fórmula cadastrada para a família <strong>${mat}</strong>.</div>`;
          return html;
        }
        // Select: usuário escolhe qual fórmula da família ver
        const selIdx =
          typeof openIdx === "number" &&
          openIdx >= 0 &&
          openIdx < cleaned.length
            ? openIdx
            : 0;
        const options = cleaned
          .map((f, i) => {
            const nome = f.formulacao || f.descricao_curta || "(sem nome)";
            const d1 = f.d1 != null ? f.d1 : (f.dureza_min ?? "");
            const d2 = f.d2 != null ? f.d2 : (f.dureza_max ?? "");
            const faixa =
              d1 !== "" && d2 !== ""
                ? `${d1}/${d2}`
                : d1 !== ""
                  ? `${d1}`
                  : "—";
            return `<option value="${i}" ${i === selIdx ? "selected" : ""}>${nome} · ${faixa}</option>`;
          })
          .join("");
        const total = cleaned.length;
        html += `
          <div class="dash-card-ff-select-wrap">
            <label class="dash-card-ff-label">Fórmula da família <strong>${mat}</strong> (${total} faixa${total === 1 ? "" : "s"}):</label>
            <select class="dash-card-ff-select">${options}</select>
          </div>
          <div class="dash-card-ff-detail">${dashFormulaCard([cleaned[selIdx]])}</div>`;
        return html;
      }

      function dashWireCardFamilyRows(slot, key) {
        const sel = slot.querySelector(".dash-card-ff-select");
        if (sel) {
          sel.addEventListener("change", () => {
            const state = dashState.cardFormulas[key];
            if (!state || state.status !== "ok") return;
            state.openIdx = Number(sel.value);
            dashLoadCardFamilyFormula(slot);
          });
        }
        if (window.lucide) lucide.createIcons();
      }

      async function dashAddFamilyAlias({ producao_mat, d, da }) {
        if (!window.supabaseClient) {
          alert("Supabase não inicializado.");
          return;
        }
        const prod = String(producao_mat || "").trim();
        if (!prod) return;
        // Pre-suggest formula_mat from remote results (first hit that matches d/da if available)
        let suggested = "";
        const remote = dashState.lkRemote || [];
        const hit =
          remote.find(
            (r) => String(r.d1) === String(d) && String(r.d2) === String(da),
          ) || remote[0];
        if (hit) suggested = String(hit.mat || "").toUpperCase();
        const formula_mat = window.prompt(
          `Mapear família de produção para fórmula em quimicadb.formula.\n\nProducao.mat = "${prod}"\n\nDigite o nome da família correspondente em quimicadb.formula:`,
          suggested,
        );
        if (!formula_mat) return;
        const cleaned = String(formula_mat).trim().toUpperCase();
        if (!cleaned) return;
        try {
          const { error } = await window.supabaseClient
            .from("rubbercity_family_alias")
            .upsert(
              { producao_mat: prod, formula_mat: cleaned },
              { onConflict: "producao_mat" },
            );
          if (error) throw error;
          alert(
            `✅ Alias criado: "${prod}" → "${cleaned}". Recarregando OFMs…`,
          );
          dashState.loaded = false;
          dashLoadAll();
        } catch (e) {
          alert(`❌ Erro ao salvar alias: ${e.message || e}`);
        }
      }

      async function dashLookupRemoteSearch(q) {
        const hint = document.getElementById("lkHint");
        const query = String(q || "").trim();
        if (!query) {
          dashState.lkRemote = [];
          dashState.lkRemoteStatus = "idle";
          if (hint)
            hint.innerHTML = `Filtra estoque/OFMs em tempo real · clique em <strong>Buscar no banco</strong> para procurar em <code>quimicadb.formula</code>`;
          dashRenderCandidates(dashState.lkLastFilter);
          return;
        }
        dashState.lkRemoteStatus = "loading";
        if (hint)
          hint.innerHTML = `🔎 Buscando "<strong>${query}</strong>" em <code>quimicadb.formula</code>…`;
        try {
          const data = await dashFetch("rubbercity-mysql-formula", {
            q: query,
            limit: 50,
          });
          const arr = Array.isArray(data)
            ? data
            : data?.data || (data ? [data] : []);
          const isEmptyRow = (o) =>
            !o ||
            typeof o !== "object" ||
            Object.values(o).every((v) => v == null || String(v).trim() === "");
          const cleaned = arr.filter((f) => !isEmptyRow(f));
          dashState.lkRemote = cleaned.map((f) => ({
            mat: f.mat || f.familia,
            d1: f.d1 != null ? f.d1 : f.dureza_min,
            d2: f.d2 != null ? f.d2 : f.dureza_max,
            formulacao: f.formulacao || f.descricao_curta,
            codigo_formula: f.id_f ?? f.codigo_formula,
            raw: f,
          }));
          dashState.lkRemoteStatus = cleaned.length ? "ok" : "empty";
          if (hint) {
            hint.innerHTML = cleaned.length
              ? `✅ <strong>${cleaned.length}</strong> resultado(s) do banco para "<strong>${query}</strong>" — marcados com <span class="dash-pill dash-pill-db">banco</span>`
              : `⚠️ Nenhum resultado em <code>quimicadb.formula</code> para "<strong>${query}</strong>" (verifique grafia, ou a fórmula pode estar inativa nf≠'X')`;
          }
          // Pre-fill the lkSearch text so the user sees the candidates filtered by their query
          const lkInput = document.getElementById("lkSearch");
          if (lkInput && lkInput.value !== query) lkInput.value = query;
          dashState.lkLastFilter = query.toLowerCase();
          dashState.lkPage = 1;
          dashRenderCandidates(query);
        } catch (e) {
          dashState.lkRemoteStatus = "err";
          dashState.lkRemoteError = e.message;
          if (hint) hint.innerHTML = `❌ Erro ao buscar no banco: ${e.message}`;
        }
      }

      const lkSearch = document.getElementById("lkSearch");
      if (lkSearch) {
        // Debounce: filtra estoque/OFMs após 120ms parados — evita travar a UI a cada tecla
        let lkSearchTimer = null;
        lkSearch.addEventListener("input", (e) => {
          const val = e.target.value;
          if (lkSearchTimer) clearTimeout(lkSearchTimer);
          lkSearchTimer = setTimeout(() => dashRenderCandidates(val), 120);
        });
        lkSearch.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
          if (e.key === "Enter") {
            e.preventDefault();
            if (lkSearchTimer) clearTimeout(lkSearchTimer);
            dashLookupRemoteSearch(e.target.value);
          }
        });
      }
      const lkDbBtn = document.getElementById("lkDbBtn");
      if (lkDbBtn)
        lkDbBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {
          const el = document.getElementById("lkSearch");
          dashLookupRemoteSearch(el ? el.value : "");
        });
      const lkToggleManual = document.getElementById("lkToggleManual");
      if (lkToggleManual)
        lkToggleManual.addEventListener("click", () => {
          const m = document.getElementById("lkManual");
          if (m) m.style.display = m.style.display === "flex" ? "none" : "flex";
        });

      const ragDocsRefreshBtn = document.getElementById("ragDocsRefreshBtn");
      if (ragDocsRefreshBtn) {
        ragDocsRefreshBtn.addEventListener("click", loadRagDocs);
      }
      const ragDocUploadBtn = document.getElementById("ragDocUploadBtn");
      const ragDocFileInput = document.getElementById("ragDocFileInput");
      if (ragDocUploadBtn && ragDocFileInput) {
        ragDocUploadBtn.addEventListener("click", () =>
          ragDocFileInput.click(),
        );
        ragDocFileInput.addEventListener("change", async (e) => {
          const file = e.target.files[0];
          if (!file) return;
          await uploadRagDoc(file);
          ragDocFileInput.value = ""; // reset
        });
      }

      const ragReindexSelectedBtn = document.getElementById(
        "ragReindexSelectedBtn",
      );
      if (ragReindexSelectedBtn) {
        ragReindexSelectedBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {
          const ids = Array.from(
            document.querySelectorAll(
              "#ragDocsTableBody input.rag-doc-check:checked",
            ),
          ).map((cb) => cb.dataset.ragDocId);
          if (ids.length === 0) return;
          reindexRagDocs(ids);
        });
      }
      const ragReindexAllBtn = document.getElementById("ragReindexAllBtn");
      if (ragReindexAllBtn) {
        ragReindexAllBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {
          const ids = Array.from(
            document.querySelectorAll("#ragDocsTableBody input.rag-doc-check"),
          ).map((cb) => cb.dataset.ragDocId);
          if (ids.length === 0) return;
          reindexRagDocs(ids);
        });
      }

      async function purgeAllRagDocs() {
        const ok = window.confirm(
          "⚠️ ATENÇÃO\n\nIsso vai APAGAR TODOS os documentos permanentes do RAG (vetores + metadados).\n\nOs arquivos no Google Drive serão MANTIDOS por padrão.\n\nConfirma?",
        );
        if (!ok) return;
        const alsoDrive = window.confirm(
          "Apagar TAMBÉM os arquivos no Google Drive?\n\n• OK → apaga vetores + arquivos no Drive\n• Cancelar → apaga só os vetores (Drive permanece)",
        );
        try {
          showRagBusy(
            alsoDrive
              ? "Apagando TUDO (Drive + vetores)... pode demorar."
              : "Apagando vetores e metadados...",
          );
          setStatus("Apagando base de conhecimento...", "warning");
          const resp = await fetch(RAG_PURGE_URL, {
            method: "POST",
            headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
            body: JSON.stringify({ deleteFromDrive: !!alsoDrive }),
          });
          if (!resp.ok) throw new Error("purge failed");
          const text = await resp.text();
          let payload = {};
          try {
            payload = text ? JSON.parse(text) : {};
          } catch (e) {}
          const count = payload.deleted_count ?? "?";
          setStatus(
            `Base limpa. ${count} documento(s) removido(s).`,
            "success",
          );
          await loadRagDocs();
        } catch (err) {
          setStatus("Erro ao apagar a base.", "error");
        } finally {
          hideRagBusy();
        }
      }

      const ragPurgeAllBtn = document.getElementById("ragPurgeAllBtn");
      if (ragPurgeAllBtn) {
        ragPurgeAllBtn.addEventListener("click", purgeAllRagDocs);
      }

      const userForm2 = document.getElementById("userForm2");
      if (userForm2) {
        userForm2.addEventListener("submit", async (e) => {
          e.preventDefault();
          const saveBtn = document.getElementById("formSaveBtn");
          const errorEl = document.getElementById("formError");
          errorEl.style.display = "none";
          saveBtn.disabled = true;
          try {
            const teamIds = getSelectedTeamIds();
            if (editingUserId) {
              const roleSelect = document.getElementById("formRole");
              const chosenRole = roleSelect.disabled
                ? currentUserRole
                : roleSelect.value;
              const { error } = await supabaseClient.rpc(USER_RPC.UPDATE, {
                p_user_id: editingUserId,
                p_full_name: document
                  .getElementById("formFullName")
                  .value.trim(),
                p_role: chosenRole,
              });
              if (error) throw error;
              const { error: teamsError } = await supabaseClient.rpc(
                RUBBERCITY_PREFIX + "admin_set_user_teams",
                { p_user_id: editingUserId, p_team_ids: teamIds },
              );
              if (teamsError) throw teamsError;
            } else {
              const email = document.getElementById("formEmail").value.trim();
              const password = document.getElementById("formPassword").value;
              const fullName = document
                .getElementById("formFullName")
                .value.trim();
              const role = document.getElementById("formRole").value;
              const { data: signupData, error: signupError } =
                await supabaseClient.auth.signUp({
                  email,
                  password,
                  options: {
                    data: {
                      full_name: fullName,
                      role,
                      company_name: "rubbercity",
                    },
                  },
                });
              if (signupError) throw signupError;
              if (signupData.user) {
                const { error: confirmError } = await supabaseClient.rpc(
                  USER_RPC.CONFIRM,
                  { p_user_id: signupData.user.id },
                );
                if (confirmError) {
                  /* warn suppressed */
                }
                if (teamIds.length > 0) {
                  const { error: teamsError } = await supabaseClient.rpc(
                    RUBBERCITY_PREFIX + "admin_set_user_teams",
                    { p_user_id: signupData.user.id, p_team_ids: teamIds },
                  );
                  if (teamsError) {
                    /* warn suppressed - user was created, just no teams */
                  }
                }
              }
            }
            document.getElementById("userFormPanel").style.display = "none";
            await loadUsersPage();
          } catch (err) {
            errorEl.textContent = err.message || "Erro ao salvar usuário.";
            errorEl.style.display = "block";
          } finally {
            saveBtn.disabled = false;
          }
        });
      }

      const deleteCancelBtn2 = document.getElementById("deleteCancelBtn");
      if (deleteCancelBtn2) {
        deleteCancelBtn2.addEventListener("click", () => {
          document.getElementById("deleteModal").style.display = "none";
        });
      }
      const deleteConfirmBtn2 = document.getElementById("deleteConfirmBtn");
      if (deleteConfirmBtn2) {
        deleteConfirmBtn2.addEventListener("click", async () => {
          const errorEl = document.getElementById("deleteModalError");
          errorEl.style.display = "none";
          deleteConfirmBtn2.disabled = true;
          try {
            const { error } = await supabaseClient.rpc(USER_RPC.DELETE, {
              p_user_id: deletingUserId,
            });
            if (error) throw error;
            document.getElementById("deleteModal").style.display = "none";
            await loadUsersPage();
          } catch (err) {
            errorEl.textContent = err.message || "Erro ao excluir usuário.";
            errorEl.style.display = "block";
          } finally {
            deleteConfirmBtn2.disabled = false;
          }
        });
      }

      window.loadUsers = loadUsersPage;
      window.showUsersPage = showUsersPage;
      window.showTeamsPage = showTeamsPage;
      window.showCategoriesPage = showCategoriesPage;

      document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
        lucide.createIcons();
      });
    </script>
  </body>
</html>
